tasks.taskName: Refine backlog items to definition of ready

steps.title: Write the user-story statement on each item in Jira
sop: Open the Backlog view of the team's Scrum board in Jira and run the refinement queue filter
Open each queued item and read the Description field for an As a / I want / So that statement
Type the user-story statement into the Description field on any item that lacks one
Click Save on each edited item
Done when no refined item lacks a user-story statement
verify: Run the refinement queue filter on the Backlog view in Jira
Open each refined item and read the Description field
Pass when every refined item shows a user-story statement

steps.title: Record testable acceptance criteria on each item in Jira
sop: Open the refinement queue on the Backlog view of the team's Scrum board in Jira
Open each refined item and click into the Acceptance Criteria field
Write criteria a tester can pass or fail without interpretation
Click Save on each item
Done when every refined item carries testable criteria
verify: Open the refined items from the Backlog view in Jira
Read the Acceptance Criteria field on each one
Pass when no item lacks acceptance criteria

steps.title: Record the session estimate on each item in Jira
sop: Open the refinement session view of the team's Scrum board in Jira
Open each item discussed in the session and set the Story Points field to the agreed estimate
Click Save on each item
Done when every refined item carries the agreed estimate
verify: Run a filter for refined items with an empty Story Points field in Jira
Count the rows the filter returns
Pass when the unestimated count equals 0

steps.title: Link identified dependencies on each item in Jira
sop: Open each refined item on the Backlog view in Jira
Click Link and add an issue link for every dependency named during refinement
Open each linked dependency and resolve it or schedule it into a sprint
Done when each dependency is resolved or scheduled via a link
verify: Open the refined items in Jira and expand the Links panel on each
Compare the links against the dependencies named in the refinement notes
Pass when declared dependencies appear as links

steps.title: Resolve open blocking questions on each item in Jira
sop: Open each item headed to Ready in Jira and read its comment thread
Answer each open blocking question in a reply or assign it to the person who can
Mark each answered question resolved in the thread
Done when 0 blocking questions remain on items headed to Ready
verify: Open the comment thread on each item headed to Ready in Jira
Scan for any question without a resolving reply
Pass when no open blocking question remains

steps.title: Complete the DoR checklist gate before marking Ready in Jira
sop: Open the transitioning item on the Scrum board in Jira and expand its DoR checklist
Tick each checklist line only after confirming the underlying field is complete
Click the transition to Ready only after every line passes
Done when the board gate passes for each transitioning item
verify: Open each item's History tab in Jira
Compare the checklist completion time against the Ready transition time
Pass when no item reached Ready with an unmet gate

steps.title: Reconcile Ready items to passing DoR checklists in Jira
sop: Open the Ready column on the team's Scrum board in Jira
Open each Ready item and read its DoR checklist state
Move any item with an unmet line back to Refinement and note the gap in a comment
Done when no Ready item shows an unmet DoR field
verify: Open each Ready item on the Scrum board in Jira and recount unmet DoR lines
Pass when the unmet-field count equals 0

steps.title: Keep each blocked item in Refinement with a documented blocker in Jira
sop: Open the Refinement column on the team's Scrum board in Jira
Open each blocked item and add a comment naming the blocker and its follow-up owner
Leave the item in the Refinement column until the blocker clears
Done when every blocked item names its blocker plus follow-up owner
verify: Filter the Refinement column to flagged items in Jira
Read the blocker comment on each blocked item
Pass when each blocked item shows blocker plus owner

steps.title: Archive the refinement session notes to the team page in Confluence
sop: Open the team space in Confluence and create a page under the refinement notes parent
Paste the week's session notes and put the session date in the page title
Click Publish
Done when the weekly session notes are posted with a date
verify: Open the refinement notes parent page in the team space in Confluence
Locate the week's child page and read its date
Pass when the dated session notes are present

steps.title: Return any story pulled without meeting DoR to the backlog in Jira
sop: Open Jira and click Create, choosing the AGILE-Exception issue type for the pulled story
Link the pulled story and describe the DoR items it missed
Drag the story out of the sprint back into the backlog on the Backlog view
Work the exception to Resolved within 1 business day
Done when the AGILE-Exception is resolved within 1 business day
verify: Search issue type AGILE-Exception for the sprint in Jira
Read the created and resolved timestamps on each ticket
Pass when none exceed the 1-day SLA

steps.title: Record the refinement close-out confirmation on the notes in Confluence
sop: Open the week's session notes page in Confluence
Confirm with the team at refinement close that the items are understood
Add a close-out confirmation entry with your name and the date at the foot of the page
Done when the close-out confirmation is recorded
verify: Open the week's session notes page in Confluence
Read the close-out entry at the foot of the page
Pass when the close-out confirmation is present
